pull.title: Test: Cover malformed merkle trees and nBits
pull.body:
Add tests for malformed partial merkle trees, including the transaction count limit at its 16666 boundary, and for `GetBitsProof` returning zero for zero, negative and overflowing targets.

These were discovered by finding gaps in an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s)

With a couple non-blocking suggestions with a couple additional mutant kills via bot:

```
With the GetBitsProof guard reduced to fNegative || bnTarget == 0, or to just fNegative, the test now fails on the 0x21012345 line. Before this change, both mutations passed.

With the nTransactions > MAX_BLOCK_WEIGHT / MIN_TRANSACTION_WEIGHT check deleted, the test fails on the max_tx_count + 1 line.
```
